section_summary.extract_value: This section reports item-level and total-score gender comparisons on the BAS-2: five items (#2, 5, 6, 7, 9) and the BAS-2 total score were higher in men, while women scored higher on item #10; the BAS-2 total difference was statistically significant (t(1031) = 2.37, p = .021) but small (mean difference = 0.10, d = 0.15). The BAS-2 mean was also compared across universities with no significant difference (F(6, 1025) = 0.69, p = .660). The section does not label multiple studies (no 'Study 1' etc.).
